name: Ruturugus

attributes.attribute: Irish hero and son of Partholón
said Ruturugus left traces on living things

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Ruturugus is an Irish hero. He numbers among the sons of Partholón, the invader of Ireland. Giraldus Cambrensis wrote that Ruturugus left his mark on living things. Scholars cannot tell whether his bloodline stayed visible or whether he was reborn in another form.

okr.objective: Present Ruturugus as an Irish hero who descends from the invader Partholón.
key_results: Ruturugus numbers among the sons of Partholón.
Giraldus Cambrensis connected him to marks left on living things.
Whether his bloodline remained visible or he was reborn is unclear.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
